source.notes: A bank of practice items (not an examination paper) published by CBSE on cbseacademic.nic.in; the introduction states there are 78 items. Items map to the NCERT books current in 2021; chapters were mapped to the current (2025-26) syllabus and must be confirmed by an editor. Items are not numbered: 'number' is the printed item identity (e.g. Science10YP3) and 'part' the printed question label inside the item (e.g. 1(a)(i)), so number+part matches the printed question IDs. Answers come from each item's own mark scheme (Answer / Guidance columns); level-of-response tables are summarised as '…'. Items on topics removed from the 2025-26 syllabus (periodic classification, sources of energy, management of natural resources, electromagnetic induction/generators/electric motor, AC/DC, evolution, class 9 topics) have chapter null. Many diagrams, graphs and tables are images or misaligned in the text layer and are flagged per question.
